resources.string:
MyFruit is an Android application for calculating the total price of fruit based on the number of fruits or weight in kilograms.

 Users can select the type of fruit, enter the quantity or weight, and the application will automatically calculate the total price.

 This application was created as part of a Mobile Programming practicum using Jetpack Compose.
